title: Quietly Better
description: Vanilla — perfected, not replaced. Refined for smoother performance, sharper visuals, and a cleaner Minecraft experience.
body:
### Quietly Better
Minecraft — refined, optimized, and polished without changing its core identity.

Quietly Better is a high-performance Vanilla+ Fabric modpack for 1.21.11 designed to enhance immersion, improve responsiveness, and modernize the experience — while keeping gameplay progression completely intact.

No overhaul.
No tech trees.
No new dimensions.
Just Minecraft — running at its best.

## Core Philosophy
This pack focuses on three pillars:

• Performance
• Immersion
• Quality of Life

Everything included serves one of those purposes.
If it doesn’t improve the experience, it doesn’t stay.

## Performance & Optimization

Built on a carefully selected optimization stack including Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, C2ME, Krypton, VMP, MoreCulling, EntityCulling, ImmediatelyFast, and more.

What this means for you:

• Stable 50-60+ FPS on mid-range systems(Vsyn - ON)
• Stable 140 - 200 + FPS on mid-range systems (V syn - OFF)
• Reduced memory usage
• Faster chunk loading
• Smoother entity processing
• Improved networking performance
• Less stuttering and micro-freezes

This is not a random pile of optimization mods — it’s a tested, compatible stack.

## Visual & Rendering Improvements

Minecraft still looks like Minecraft — just cleaner.

• Iris shader support
• Better biome blending
• Dynamic lighting
• Subtle particle and environmental effects
• Improved clouds and sky visuals
• 3D skin layers
• Enhanced GUI smoothness
• Better advancement screen

Visual upgrades are designed to feel natural, not exaggerated.

## Immersive Audio

The world feels alive without being overwhelming.

• Ambient environmental soundscapes
• Realistic sound physics
• Presence-based footstep sounds
• Improved directional awareness

You hear the world differently — and it feels deeper.

## Animal & Companion Improvements

Subtle but meaningful tweaks to mobs and pets.

• Enhanced wolves and companions
• Persistent parrots
• Improved cat behavior
• Visible wandering traders
• Better mob interaction behavior
- Camels now drop cactus

Animals feel smarter and more responsive without breaking balance.

## Quality of Life Enhancements

Hundreds of micro-improvements that add up to a smoother experience:

• Smooth scrolling
• Better inventory management
• Searchable interfaces
• Shulker box tooltips
• Durability tooltips
• Status effect bars
• Better F3 screen
• Control improvements
• Zoom functionality
• Elytra handling improvements
• Friendly fire toggle
• Cleaner HUD elements
• Faster eating
• Enchantment descriptions
• Book inspection tools

These changes don’t alter progression — they remove friction.

## World & Exploration Refinements

• Tectonic world generation polish
• Better structure integration
• Cleaner biome transitions
• Smarter chunk pre-generation compatibility

Exploration feels smoother and more coherent.

Stability & Compatibility

Carefully tested with over 200 curated mods.
No experimental chaos.
No unstable junk.

Recommended RAM:
6GB minimum
8GB recommended

## Who Is This For?

Players who:

• Love vanilla Minecraft
• Want smoother performance
• Appreciate subtle polish
• Prefer stability over flashy content
• Want Vanilla+, not modded overhaul

ALL CREDITS FOR MODS, RESOURCEPACKS, and shaders go to their original creators. You guys have done a wonderful job!

### # Final Notes

We never really left it untouchable! We added resourcify so you can add more resource packs, respackopts so you can modify them, and Via Fabric Plus so you can go to any server, regardless of your client's version! (Note: some servers with heavy anti-cheats may block you by thinking you are using a hacked client) mod menu so you can see all the mods you're playing and their info!
